description: Permits a six-unit residential building at 1401 11th Street West.
This rezoning allows higher density than current rules permit.

chips.text: Councillor Derek argued current policy is not flexible enough for larger corner sites.
Residents of the Holiday Park neighborhood.
Administration recommended denial, but the motion to deny was defeated.
Administration warned approval would set a precedent for intensification outside transit areas.
69 of 75 public respondents and the Holiday Park Community Association opposed the rezoning.
One councillor voted for denial, citing community opposition and parking concerns.

segments.title: Administration Presentation
segments.takeaway: Administration presented their report, recommending denial of the rezoning application due to non-alignment with infill policies and community opposition.

segments.title: Questions for Administration
segments.takeaway: Committee members asked administration about the infill policy, spot zoning concerns, waste disposal requirements, traffic impact assessments, and the impact of public support on their recommendation.
